name: browser-use
headline: ICLR 2025 Agent Papers: Rated & Curated
short_description: A curated, rated list of agent-related paper submissions from ICLR 2025, sorted by average reviewer scores. Useful for researchers and practitioners tracking the latest AI agent research.
author: Aaron617

sections.overview:
ICLR-2025-Submissions-Agent is a reference repository compiling agent-related paper submissions from the ICLR 2025 conference, each listed with its OpenReview link and average reviewer rating. Papers span topics including multi-agent systems, LLM-based agents, embodied agents, GUI agents, cybersecurity evaluation, code generation, and agentic workflow automation. The list is sorted by average rating, making it straightforward to identify the highest-regarded submissions in the agent research space. Researchers, engineers, and AI practitioners can use this resource to quickly survey the state of agent-focused work at one of the field's leading venues without manually searching OpenReview.
Survey top-rated AI agent papers from ICLR 2025 in one place
Identify high-scoring research on multi-agent collaboration and LLM-driven agents
Find benchmarks and evaluation frameworks for language model agents (e.g., MLE-Bench, Cybench, DSBench)
Track embodied agent and GUI agent research trends from a major ML conference
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Aaron617/ICLR-2025-Submissions-Agent`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an ICLR 2025 submissions agent. Provide a list of 5-10 agent-related papers that would be relevant for the ICLR 2025 conference. Include the paper titles, authors, and a brief summary of each paper's contribution to the field of AI agents. Focus on papers that have been published in the last 12 months.
```
